description:
Woh call jo aap do din se taal rahe ho. VedicHour aapke din ke saare 18 ghanton ko aapki apni birth chart ke against score karta hai, aur har ghante ke saath ek plain line deta hai - ki woh window kis kaam ke liye theek hai. Kuch windows clearer hote hain, kuch heavier. Sab kuch asli astronomical data se nikalta hai, andaaze se nahi, aur plain English mein likha jata hai.
